title: Equality of treatment for Persons with Disabilities
description: Context: Experts has called for a radical restructuring of India’s disability welfare architecture by establishing a uniform nationwide pension system. Transitioning disability support from discretionary charity to a clear, legally backed citizenship right is both a constitutional duty and an effective economic investment. “Disability inclusion in nutrition and health services is critical for social equity”. Evaluate the challenges and strategies to make these services more accessible to persons with disabilities in India. (15 M)

title: UPSC Editorial Analysis: India’s Gold Dependency
description: General Studies-3; Topic: Indian Economy and issues relating to planning, mobilization of resources, growth, development and employment. Economic models often fail to predict Indian gold consumption because the demand is vertical (inelastic to price changes). This stems from three primary factors: While gold helps individual households feel secure, importing large volumes of a non-productive asset creates significant macroeconomic vulnerabilities: Past government policies tried to curb gold demand by making it more expensive or offering paper alternatives, but they generally failed because they did not fix the underlying reasons why people buy gold.
